notes: New owner-issued record for V2-095's M5 re-dogfood. It NAMES NO EXISTING RECORD AND REUSES NO EXISTING LEDGER: its limits.ledger_path is /home/takushi/.local/state/agentic-loop/v2/V2-095-provider-live-claude-redogfood-cost.json, which does not exist yet, and its accounting starts from an empty ledger. Not one byte of V2-017-provider-cost.json, V2-022-provider-cost.json, V2-063-provider-live-claude-refresh-cost.json, V2-075-provider-live-claude-rebind-cost.json or V2-080-provider-live-claude-pooled-cost.json changes; no earlier record's thresholds are raised; no halted flag is cleared; no ledger is re-initialised. internal/runner/costledger.go re-verifies the preflight digest and all three limit values on EVERY reservation, so editing an approved record invalidates its ledger instead of raising the cap, and the only remedy for a reached threshold is a new record. SIZING IS BY INVOCATION COUNT, and the decisive measurement is that costledger.go:364 refuses when len(Entries)+1 exceeds max_invocations, so a RESERVATION counts whether or not it settles. Re-measured in this worktree, all five existing ledgers agree with dp-v2-095 d14 exactly: V2-017 9 settled + 2 reserved = 11 of 16; V2-022 16 + 7 = 23 of 24; V2-063 8 + 3 = 11 of 12; V2-075 9 + 3 = 12 of 12; V2-080 8 + 2 = 10 of 48; halted false on all five. Seventeen of sixty-seven reservations, 25.37 percent, never settled. V2-022's purpose histogram is decisive and is re-measured here: V2-022-autonomous-resolution 9 (all settled), V2-022-graceful-stop-live-child 7 (ALL SEVEN reserved, never settled, because that purpose kills the child by construction), V2-022-resume-after-channel-rollback 7 (all settled). THE ARITHMETIC. One full run of TestFoundationPreviewLocalDogfood is exactly THREE reservations, of which two can settle and one can never settle. Four runs are planned: two for the stability pair A15 requires on the identical final commit, one to BREAK a tie rather than leave one standing (which is the failure V2-022's own A19 reported about itself, at 23 of 24 with no headroom), and one to confirm after any post-observation fix. That is 4 times 3 equals 12. V2-022's measured rate was 23 reservations for seven runs, or 3.29 per run, so 24 admits 24 divided by 3.29 equals 7.2 runs at the measured rate -- nearly twice the plan. max_invocations is therefore 24. THE MONETARY ARITHMETIC, shown because it is NOT true that money is far away for the reason usually given. costledger.go:350-368 blocks the FULL worst_case_reservation_usd for an UNSETTLED reservation and min(actual, reserved) for a settled one, then refuses when settled + reserved + worst_case exceeds max_total_cost_usd. Measured, V2-022 stood at 1.008563 settled plus 7.00 reserved plus the 1.00 worst-case reservation, which is 9.008563 of 20.00 -- 45.0 percent of the money at 96 percent of the count. So money is not the binding threshold, but not because settlements are cheap: because unsettled reservations at 1.00 each are still only a third of the ceiling. At the same shape, 24 reservations of which a third never settle stands near 9 to 10 of 20.00, so max_total_cost_usd is 20.00 and stays a second, so-far-inert runaway stop rather than the operative one. Thresholds here are runaway-detection stops, never billing ceilings; reaching one halts the exercise for inspection and is reported as neither a success nor a failure. environment.base_names is exactly HOME and PATH and granted_names is EMPTY: the claude CLI reads its own on-disk credential store and the Secret Broker has nothing to hand it. provider.version is 2.1.246, RE-MEASURED on this machine; V2-080's record and artifact both record 2.1.241 and neither is edited.

rollback.trigger: the ledger reaches max_invocations or max_total_cost_usd (runaway-detection stop), or a single settled invocation exceeds the anomaly threshold and the ledger's halted flag is set
completion_conditions: no further claude invocations are made for this task without a new, freshly-approved provider-preflight record
the ledger's halted flag, once set, is cleared only by the owner issuing a new approved record, never by editing this record or the ledger file in place

reaching max_invocations or max_total_cost_usd stops the exercise for inspection and is reported as neither a success nor a failure; the limits in this record are never raised and this ledger is never re-initialised to reset the count

the observation commit is recorded and made unreachable-proof by a durable ref pushed to origin, because gate rule G6b measures the diff between that commit and the judging commit and an unreachable observation commit makes the intersection unmeasurable

the intersection between that diff and the published exercise file set is measured with a positive and a negative control, not argued: an unmeasured intersection fails G6b, and a zero with no positive control is not accepted
